descriptionChirho: Proper noun denoting Nahor, borne by two individuals in Genesis: (1) the grandfather of Abraham, son of Serug (Gen 11:22-25, 1 Chr 1:26), and (2) the brother of Abraham, son of Terah, father of Bethuel and grandfather of Rebekah and Laban (Gen 11:26-29, 22:20,23, 24:10,15,24,47, 29:5, 31:53, Josh 24:2). The three clusters differ only grammatically: standalone 'Nahor' (16x), conjunctive 'and-Nahor' (1x), and variant form 'Nachor' (1x). Consistently transliterated: Spanish Nacor/Najor, Hindi नचोर/नाहोर, Arabic نَاحُور, Korean 나호르/나홀, Swahili Nahori.
